lq.q: Given Memory Blocks (KB): 100, 500, 200, 300, 600 Processes (KB): 212, 417, 112, 426 Give Best Fit and Worst Fit Allocation. Which strategy caused more fragmentation and why?
answer: Worst Fit caused more internal fragmentation because it allocates large blocks to small processes, leaving large leftover memory chunks that may not be reused efficiently. (20%)
